section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch21 — Contemporary Educational Concerns
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A teacher notices that boys are called on more often to answer maths questions while girls are asked to help with classroom tidying. Addressing this pattern relates most directly to:

options.option_text: Gender sensitivity and equity in classroom practice

explanation: Unequal classroom participation by gender is a gender-equity concern requiring conscious, bias-free teacher practice.

section: Child Development & Pedagogy · Ch21 — Contemporary Educational Concerns
subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: The Supreme Court of India has directed that environmental education be made compulsory at which level(s) of education?

options.option_text: All levels, from school to university

explanation: Following Supreme Court directions (M.C. Mehta case), environmental education has been mandated across all levels of formal education.

stem: Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG-4), adopted by the United Nations, commits countries to:

options.option_text: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning for all
Provide free higher education only to boys
Replace all school education with online learning

explanation: SDG-4 is the global education goal: inclusive, equitable, quality education and lifelong learning for all, by 2030.
